answer: Concretely, the economy can force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its river recurs, its juniper survives audit, and a quill from an unlinked peer confirms it.
